name: Tablet customer changes the basket quantity and removes the tester
fullName: features/tester_purchase.feature:Tablet customer changes the basket quantity and removes the tester
description:
To try a paint colour at home before buying a full tin
As a Dulux customer
I want to add a tester for a chosen shade to my basket

The same basket edit on a tablet (TC-27), at 768 px wide.

steps.name: Given a tablet customer has a tester for shade "Romantic Reverie" in the basket
When the customer increases the tester quantity
When the customer decreases the tester quantity
And the tester quantity cannot be decreased any further
When the customer removes the tester from the basket
